about: x's decision table (the P3 procedure), read from this pack's handlers and doors. Every served operation is a handler: an OAuth leg is a credential exchange kept by its SHA-256, not a stored body; POST /2/tweets is an original post, a reply or a quote by a field of its body; every read answers X's default fields unless tweet.fields asks for more, with includes; a lookup of an id nobody posted is a partial 200; media is uploaded in chunks and a video processed. The derived core owns none. Every operation no row names is the gap (the manifest's unmodeled list), X's 404 problem. No root is bound to X (the manifest's vendorBacked.none), so nothing here is performed on X or refreshed from it. x.com's composer (screens/home.tsx) makes its writes through these same handlers, as the signed-in account.

decisions.why: the developer console's Apps section gives an App's owner its API Key and Secret, the owner's personal Access Token and Secret and its OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Secret; no API makes an App or issues the owner's personal token. Made once with the owner's account and answered again after, writing nothing: first-use.json's post.mjs signs v2.me, v2.tweet, v2.singleTweet and v2.userTimeline with them and asserts the account, the post and its place on the timeline
